evidence: 008 (swarm-14, no diff): reserved ContextBlocks with char limits + readOnly enforced at write time; ContextBudget overview computed by assembler (read-only to agent); fail-closed exact-match memory edits. File: src/tenanos/context/blocks.ts.

090 (proposed, diffs/P-20260923-090.diff): execution budgets ledger. Six dimensions (attempts, wall-time, tool-calls, context, artifact-size, parallel-workers), nesting tenant>mission>run>attempt, CheckResult values, fail-closed reservation. Its 'context' dimension is a scalar ceiling (maxContextChars) on total context consumption.
090's own STATE notes already triage this: 'P-20260923-008 (context blocks) composes as context-assembly, no conflict with D4 ledger.' Independent confirmation of complementarity.

091 (integrated): decision-budget reference implementation: escalation taxonomy, bounded auto-resolvers, escalation envelope, metrics, hook-points. Pure classification over decision situations; no context structure, no block concept, no char limits. Zero topical overlap with 008.

008 operates at context ASSEMBLY time (which blocks, per-block limits, readOnly, overview); 090 operates at execution LEDGER time (how much total may be spent, reservation-before-spend). Different layers, different authorities, no shared state.

File scope: src/tenanos/context/blocks.ts is unclaimed by any other proposal (verified against STATE.json); no src/tenanos/context/ exists on the integration branch. No file overlap with 090 (src/tenanos/budgets.ts) or 091 (src/tenanos/decision-budget/).
notes: Implementation at impl/P-20260923-008/: blocks.ts (strict TS) + jest test proving (1) readOnly blocks reject writes, (2) char limits enforced at write time with no silent truncation, (3) exact-match edit fails closed on mismatch and applies on match, (4) overview computes per-block usage and totals, (5) the overview is deeply frozen (read-only to the agent). The overview accepts an optional ceilingChars injected by the caller: this is the composition seam with 090's context dimension; blocks.ts never imports budgets.ts.

overlaps.resolution: 090 owns the ledger (how much context may be spent); 008 owns the assembly (how it is structured and reported). The typed overview's ceilingChars parameter is fed by 090's run-ledger context dimension when both are integrated; neither duplicates the other.
Escalation taxonomy vs context structure. No shared concepts.
